$Comment: Martha's Cookbook: cook each of Martha's three dishes once, at a Chef's Stove, from the recipes her
_Marthas_Roast.json). CRAFT_ITEM counts each dish made, Target the dish's own item id, and every
criterion must complete; each criterion's TextKey words its step. The Roast's recipe opens only at
Family, so most players finish this in a later feast.
Earned once and kept: the recipes stay learned from one feast to the next, so this file has no
Parent and no full_table tag. Its gift waits in Rewards.Claim on the achievements page: Harvest
Coins, Spices for more cooking (every dish takes one), and MMO Skill Tree's Mmo_Xp row, Crafting XP
as the cooking quests pay. The Mmo_Xp row's own Requires, the hytale:mod_installed gate, leaves it
out on a server without that mod, unpaid and unshown, and the rest still pays. The _Harvest_Feast
folder makes the id harvest_feast_marthas_cookbook, and its words come from the keys that id spells.
